name: Aqua-Terrarium 100x45x45/30 +3D
label: Large terrarium
lead: Combined aqua-terrarium measuring 100x45x45 cm with a handmade 3D background. Ideal for animals that need both a land and a water section in their habitat. Water section height: 30 cm.

description.html: At 100 cm long, this is the longest aqua-terrarium among our standard models. The floor measures 100x45 cm, the height is 45 cm, and the bottom 30 cm is intended for water. Filled to that level, the water section holds about 135 liters, so a medium-sized turtle can swim the full length and dive instead of standing in the shallows.

Above the water, 15 cm remains for the land area, the lamp and air. The back is closed off by a 3D background of hand-carved styrofoam shaped like rock, so the animal has a calm wall behind it instead of clear glass. The water alone weighs about 135 kg, which is why this model belongs on a sturdy cabinet or stand, never on an ordinary shelf.
A meter of length and 30 cm of water are of most use to these species:

items: Amphibians that need an aquatic section

description.html: If you need shallower water for young turtles or more land for a water dragon, we change that ratio by agreement, together with the overall dimensions. We cover the outer sides with a film that you choose from 34 patterns. A custom model of this size takes us 7 to 14 days to build, and we ship it by courier anywhere in Serbia. Before ordering, check the load capacity of the floor and of the cabinet where it will stand.
